title: Approaching the ceiling alerts the organization owner
description:
**Phase 4 of 5.**

- **Blocked by:** the ceiling story
- **Runs in parallel with:** the stop story and the display story
- **Unblocks:** nothing

---
Warning before stopping. The alert exists so that crossing the ceiling is never the first time someone hears about it — a hard stop with no warning is indistinguishable from an outage, and it arrives on the desk of the person who vouched for us internally.

budget_alerts.py and budget_rollup/ already do this work for Anthus-side budgets. This points the same machinery at a per-organization ceiling on a customer account.

**Done when:** the scenarios exist and fail for the right reason.

comments.author: unknown
comments.text:
Feature: Organization spend ceiling

  Scenario: Crossing the warning threshold alerts the owner
    Given an enabled organization with a monthly spend ceiling
    When its month-to-date AWS spend passes the warning threshold
    Then its owner is alerted with the current spend and the ceiling

  Scenario: One alert per threshold per month
    Given an organization whose owner has been alerted at the warning threshold
    When more spend is recorded in the same month below the ceiling
    Then no further warning alert is sent

  Scenario: A new month starts quiet
    Given an organization alerted at the warning threshold last month
    When a new month begins
    Then the alert may be sent again
